About the project brief

The project-brief form currently works in your browser. It does not submit your entries to Meridius, store them in a database, or save them in browser storage. The download is created locally after you choose to prepare your brief.

About the concept sites

The eight sample businesses are fictional design previews. Their enquiry forms demonstrate an interaction and do not send messages or make reservations.

Site resources

Images and application code are served with the website. Fonts may be requested from Google Fonts. The hosting provider may process standard request information to deliver the website.
